name: Hard Seltzer
siboNotes: Plain hard seltzers are typically FODMAP-free, but alcohol can irritate sensitive digestive systems and may worsen SIBO symptoms in some individuals.
preparationTips: Choose brands with simple ingredients (carbonated water, alcohol, natural flavors)
Avoid varieties with added fruit juices or artificial sweeteners
Check labels for high-FODMAP additives like inulin or high-fructose corn syrup
Consume in moderation as alcohol can affect gut bacteria balance
nutritionalHighlights: No carbohydrates or sugars in plain varieties
Hydrating due to high water content
